news.contents: Miami Dolphins wide receiver Malik Washington has deep-league upside in Week 11 as his team heads to Buffalo to take on the Bills. He hauled in all three of his targets for 50 yards last week against the Colts and threw a 34-yard touchdown on his one pass attempt on a trick play. Washington is up to 400 yards and a touchdown in his nine games this season and has been one of the most targeted options in the passing game. He doesn't have quite as much upside as his teammate Caleb Douglas, but he...
news.title: Malik Washington Brings Deep-League Appeal Against the Bills

news.analysis: Despite exiting the game early due to a hip issue, Boutte caught his third TD of the season Thursday night. It's difficult to project Boutte week-to-week, as he caught his previous two touchdown passes in Week 9 only to post a goose egg in Week 10. The 24-year-old speedster fits the boom-or-bust label quite well.
news.contents: Kayshon Boutte hauled in both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts.
news.title: Kayshon Boutte hits paydirt in Week 11 win

news.contents: Houston Texans wide receiver Kayshon Boutte (hip) was moving well after his team's Week 11 win over the Indianapolis Colts on Thursday night and appears to have avoided a serious hip injury, per Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston. The 24-year-old finished the night with two catches for 40 yards and a touchdown on two targets and has now hauled in 21 catches for 359 yards and three touchdowns on 31 targets across 10 games. news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders running back Mike Washington Jr. still has fantasy value to offer as his team prepares to face the Denver Broncos in Week 11.
